senses.gloss: f. (טָהַר) water pipe of a bath, gutter.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 6:11">Mikv. VI, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 5:8">Tosef. ib. V, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:4">Ib. VI, 4</cite> <he>בזמן שמ׳ שלה וכ׳</he> when the gutter of the bath opens into private ground.—Pl. <he>מְטָהֲרוֹת</he>. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 9.
